newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich-U.S. estate tax change to strengthen bill.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich-U.S. estate tax change to strengthen bill.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Wednesday House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer will propose changes to the estate tax provision in his bill which would "strengthen" the legislation.
"He will be offering amendments to strengthen provisions on the death taxes," Gingrich, a Georgia Republican, told reporters.
Archer, a Texas Republican, had originally proposed increasing the threshold where estate taxes kick in to $1 million gradually from the current $600,000.
Critics had said the initial proposal phased in the higher threshold too gradually because it would reach the $1 million mark in 2014.

Archer's new planned proposal would move $10 billion over 10 years from his proposed phase out of the corporate alternative minimum tax into the estate tax relief portion of his legislation, a committee aide said.
